full_prompt_en: A square anime action illustration shows a group of school-uniformed young people rushing toward the viewer through a sunlit city street as bright blue energy curls around them. Tall tan stone buildings flank the background, with arches and repeated windows rising along the left. A patch of vivid blue sky opens between the facades at the top. The central girl has long chestnut hair streaming backward and wide brown eyes. She leans forward with one arm outstretched over a luminous cyan spiral in the lower right, while her white shirt, yellow tie, and blue-green skirt move with the action. Behind her, a dark-haired boy and a pale-haired boy advance from the upper center in similar light shirts and ties. On the left, a shorter dark-haired girl in a cap runs with the group, partly framed by the building. On the right, a bald bespectacled figure leans in from the edge, his serious face set against dark architecture. Electric blue ribbons sweep across the lower frame and rise at the sides, producing small white sparks and reflected cyan highlights on clothing. The ground beneath is only partly visible as warm paving and blue shadow; bodies overlap strongly and the perspective feels low and close. Fine dark linework defines faces and folds, while smoother gradient shading gives hair, fabric, and stone volume. Daylight arrives from the upper left, warming building edges, but the magical swirl provides a stronger cool light near the outstretched hand. The overall composition drives diagonally forward, balancing a tight cluster of expressive figures against sunlit stone and kinetic blue arcs.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形动画动作插画呈现一群穿校服的年轻人冲过阳光中的城市街道，明亮蓝色能量在他们身边卷动。高大的棕黄色石建筑夹住背景，左侧的拱门与重复窗户向上升起。顶部立面间打开一片鲜蓝天空。中央女孩留着向后飘起的栗色长发，棕色眼睛睁大。她前倾伸出一只手，手下右方有一圈发亮的青蓝色旋流；白衬衫、黄色领带和蓝绿色裙子随动作飘动。她后方，深发男孩与浅发男孩从上部中央推进，身穿类似浅色衬衫和领带。左边，一名戴帽的矮个深发女孩与众人奔跑，部分被建筑围住。右边，一名戴眼镜的光头人物从边缘探入，严肃面容立于深色建筑前。电蓝色光带扫过下方并从两侧升起，在衣服上生成小白色火花和反射青光。脚下地面只露出部分暖色铺地和蓝色阴影；身体强烈重叠，透视感低而近。细深线条界定面孔与衣褶，更平滑的渐层阴影给予头发、布料和石材体积。日光从左上方进入，温暖建筑边缘，但魔法旋流在伸出的手附近提供更强冷光。整体构图沿斜线向前推进，以紧凑的富表情人物群平衡阳光石建筑与高速蓝弧。
style_prompt_en: The anime action style combines clean expressive contours, layered cel-like shading, and bright volumetric effects. Warm tan and sky blue establish an open setting, while concentrated electric cyan makes the lower focal zone feel charged. Foreshortened shapes and overlapping silhouettes build forward motion, supported by diagonal arcs that curve across the frame. Faces and clothing retain crisp graphic detail; background structure softens slightly so it does not compete. Cool emitted light paints narrow highlights onto nearby surfaces, while broader natural light supplies warm midtones. Small sparks and luminous rings add texture without obscuring the readable central forms. The overall effect is energetic and cinematic, using clear character staging, complementary color temperature, and controlled motion lines.
style_prompt_zh: 这种动画动作风格结合清晰表情轮廓、层叠赛璐珞式阴影和明亮的体积光效。暖棕与天蓝建立开放场域，集中的电青色使下方焦点区域充满能量。透视缩短的形状与互相遮挡的剪影建立向前运动，由穿过画面的斜向弧线支撑。面孔与衣服保持清晰图形细节；背景结构略柔化，不与其争夺注意。冷色自发光在附近表面画出窄高光，较宽的自然光提供暖中间调。小火花与亮环增添纹理，却不遮挡易读的中央形体。整体效果富能量且有电影感，由清楚的主体编排、互补色温和受控动势线塑造。
theme_en: A school-uniform anime group rushing through a city with blue energy spirals
theme_zh: 穿校服的动画人物群穿过城市，周围旋绕蓝色能量
name: A Certain Magical Index
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
